articleTitle: A summary and current analysis of research on precision teaching in China
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: To further understand the current situation of precision teaching research in China, this paper analyzes 1,118 documents on precision teaching in China from 2009 to November 2021 and finds two trends in precision teaching research in China. One is to promote the construction of accurate teaching models and the implementation of precision teaching based on data technology and intelligent environments. The other is that the research content of precision teaching in China has gradually diversified. Current research still has shortcomings, such as no systematic precision teaching concepts, novel teaching models, etc. Continuing to pay attention to precision teaching supported by technology, developing systematic precision teaching concepts, and implementing precision teaching practices are tasks that need to be strengthened in the future.

articleTitle: Research on recommendation of learning resources at home and abroad from the perspective of wisdom education - visual analysis based on CiteSpace knowledge map
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: It is of great significance to analyze the hot content and research topics of learning resource recommendation research at home and abroad and to study the personalized recommendation technology of learning resources against the background of wisdom education. Therefore, this paper takes the domestic and foreign literature data of learning resource recommendation research collected by CNKI and Web of Science from 2006 to 2021 as the data source. With the help of bibliometrics and CiteSpace visual analysis software, the knowledge map of keyword co-occurrence, keyword clustering, keyword time zone and research institution collaboration network is analyzed. We explore the development of learning resource recommendation research at home and abroad from 2006 to 2021 and the research hotspots in recent years. The research shows that the number of published studies at home and abroad is increasing year by year. Domestic research on learning resource recommendation focuses on personalized recommendations of learning resources, recommendation algorithms and learning modes. Foreign countries focus on model construction, behavior prediction and resource recommendation. Domestic scholars and research institutions lack a sense of cooperation, there is basically no cooperative relationship among universities, and there is a lack of cooperation among foreign scholars, but research institutions cooperate closely.

articleTitle: Study on application of simulation software in teaching of design on fire protection of buildings
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Application of the simulation software to the teaching in design on fire protection of buildings is explored in the present study. The main content of the course and the difficulty in teaching are analyzed. The Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), which can be used in simulating fire development, smoke propagation and the personnel evacuation process in fire, is adopted in combination with course teaching. Based upon the outline of the design on the fire protection of buildings, three instance analyses are conducted corresponding to three typical sections, including the foundation of the fire protection of buildings, the overall plan arrangement of buildings, and the personnel safety evacuation design. The combination of the simulation results and the teaching contents are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Research progress and trends of classroom teaching behavior coding
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Classroom teaching behavior coding has received widespread attention from classroom analysis researchers in China in recent years. However, in the context of big data, how to effectively analyze the data of classroom teaching behavior is an important problem that urgently needs to be solved. In combination with bibliometric means, 422 articles published from 2004 to 2022 are encoded and analyzed. The analysis found that with the vigorous development of classroom teaching behavior coding, a new trend of interdisciplinary integration and the applied topic fields are gradually expanding from micro to macro.

articleTitle: New progress in online learning behavior analysis in an intelligent education environment
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Driven by new technology, including big data and artificial intelligence, online education has ushered in an unprecedented momentum of development, and it has become the new normal of globalization. Learning behavior analysis is one of the important contents of learning analysis, which is helpful for teaching management and implementors to formulate more specific and personalized learning support service strategies and suggestions for different objects to continuously improve the effectiveness of online learning. In recent years, with the development of technology, research on online learning behavior has been deepening in different disciplines and has achieved fruitful results. This paper uses the CiteSpace visualization analysis tool of scientific knowledge mapping. Combined with the characteristics of cross-disciplines, this paper compared and analyzed the number of papers published, key word co-occurrence map and time sequence map of research frontiers and sorted out the research hotspots, evolution, and development of online learning behavior analysis. Finally, the research trends and technical challenges of online learning behavior are explored to provide a reference for subsequent related research.

articleTitle: Building of the 6C English education system for Sanya citizens under the background of Hainan free trade port construction
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The construction of Hainan Free Trade Port (FTP) needs to create a good international language environment, which requires the participation of all citizens. As the pioneering area for FTP, Sanya citizens' low English proficiency cannot meet the needs of the construction of FTP and international development. Through in-depth investigation and cluster analysis on the English proficiency of Sanya citizens, it is found that the proportion of citizens whose English proficiency is around beginner level is as high as 50.5%. Therefore, a 6C (Citizens, Classification, College, Community-based Education, Cyber Platform, Communication) learning system for comprehensively improving English proficiency has been constructed, which hopes to provide a practical, effective, operable, and generalizable methodology for optimizing the international language environment in Sanya. It has theoretical and practical reference value.

articleTitle: XGBoost-based student performance prediction in tiered instruction
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Student performance prediction is one of the most important subjects in educational data mining. As a modern technology, machine learning has the capabilities of feature extraction and data modeling, which provides necessary guarantee for diversified application scenarios. However, machine learning methods have not been integrated with practical teaching strategies after diverse prediction experiments in modern education. In addition, massive features are directly utilized as input variables for machine learning algorithms, which can cause a certain degree of information redundancy. Therefore, it is necessary to select an appropriate model to predict student performance and integrate the prediction results with actual teaching scenarios. In this work, XGBoost is utilized for student performance prediction, since it has been verified as an effective tool in classification task. Specifically, we collect original educational data and utilize feature analysis to select correlated features as input variables, and the selected features are feed into XGBoost model. In experimental part, XGBoost model achieves the better results than five other classic machine learning models. Based on the results of the classification of students, tiered instruction is applied, and different teaching objectives and contents are set for all levels of students.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of classroom teaching behavior based on teaching video
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Based on iFIAS, first, the videos are encoded and analyzed by the Assistant and Assistant Tool. We tidied the data on instructional interaction behavior. Second, the lower limit and higher limit of the ratio of students' verbal behavior are calculated through SPSS. High verbal classroom H is the classroom with the ratio of students' verbal behavior beyond the higher limit. Low verbal classroom L is the classroom with the ratio of students' verbal behavior under the lower limit. Finally, the average of different instructional interaction behavior data is statistically analyzed on H and L. Combined with video viewing, we compare H and L, draw some conclusions from the perspective of teachers' verbal behavior, students' verbal behavior, silence and technology applications, and give suggestions for L to adjust learning situations.

articleTitle: An empirical study of pedagogical content knowledge of middle school English teachers in Yunnan ethnic minority areas
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: This study investigates the current situation of English teachers' Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK) in middle schools in the ethnic minority areas of Yunnan Province. A total of 439 English teachers were selected from middle schools in these eight ethnic minority areas of Yunnan Province. The collected data were analyzed by SPSS 22.0. The following conclusions have been drawn: the general situation of English teacher's PCK was good; there was a significant, positive and intermediate relationship between English proficiency and the six PCK factors; the important PCK predictors of teachers' English proficiency were teaching strategy knowledge and organizational content knowledge, and the important PCK predictors of teacher's teaching ability were knowledge about students and effect feedback knowledge; there were significant differences in English teachers' PCK in terms of school.

articleTitle: Research on personalized learning space in educational metaverse
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Educational applications of metaverses should be considered as a medium for sustainable education. In this paper, we propose a general personalized learning space in the educational metaverse (PLSEM) framework, which incorporates VR and AR technologies to simulate the complex learning interactions. This paper analyzes the effects of the metaverse on learning from the perspectives of teaching principles, learning activity design and technology application. Learners' emotional input and cognitive level were effectively improved through the convergence of various technologies. The relationship between learning motivation and the environment was examined by analyzing previous studies. Furthermore, PLSEM can be used to provide online learning space similar to an offline classroom for students by creating innovative educational environments.

articleTitle: A study on the correlation between information technology and mathematics achievement in senior high school
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Information technology courses shoulder the important responsibility and mission of cultivating students with information literacy. In this paper, according to the design of the questionnaire and in-depth practice of senior high school information technology core literacy, the score of subject ability to carry out correlation analysis and regression analysis of information technology and mathematics scores. The analysis results show that there is a significant correlation between information technology and mathematics, and the correlation between information technology and ordinary classes is greater than that of key classes, which proves that it is necessary to carry out curriculum integration in information technology and mathematics.

articleTitle: A hierarchical multilabel classification method based ON clustering relation
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: In multilabel classification, the problems of a large number of classification calculations and easy destruction of label relations are very common. To solve these problems, a hierarchical multilabel classification method based on clustering relations is proposed by mining the possible dependencies between labels. First, the algorithm adopts a local strategy to cluster labels multiple times. Then, the clusters of labels with hierarchical relation are formed, and the implicit relationships hidden in these clusters are analyzed. On this basis, a multilabel clustered clustering tree is constructed to train the local model. Finally, the clustering tree is constructed as a random forest classification model using the ensemble idea. The experimental results show that the method in this paper has a good classification performance, especially on datasets with a large amount of data, which is at least percentage points higher than the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Exploring a multi-stage feedback teaching mode for graduate students of software engineering discipline based on project-driven competition
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the current problems of theory-oriented, practice-light, and lack of innovation ability in the teaching of postgraduate software engineering courses, a multi-stage feedback teaching mode for software engineering postgraduates based on competition project-driven is proposed. The model is driven by the competition project, and implementing suggestions are given in terms of stage allocation of software engineering course tasks and ability cultivation, competition case design and process evaluation improvement, etc. Through the implementation of this teaching mode, students' enthusiasm and initiative are expected to be stimulated, and the overall development of students' professional skills and comprehension ability would be improved to meet the demand of society for software engineering technical talents.

articleTitle: Analysis of learning behavior characteristics based on process evaluation data
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Strengthening process evaluation is an important topic in the current educational evaluation reform. Applying process evaluation to the current popular blended teaching will help promote the process of educational evaluation reform. In this paper, a process evaluation index system for blended teaching is constructed based on the Delphi method and the AHP. The evaluation data are collected in the actual course, and the K-means clustering algorithm is used to mine and analyze the characteristics of students' learning behavior under the blended teaching mode. It is found that under the process evaluation model, students can be divided into five types of learners: independent research type, confident and flexible type, digital ability type, cooperative and mutual aid type, and learning difficulty type. The main learning behaviors are learning engagement, classroom performance, online learning, assignment submission, unit assessment and problem solving. The polarization is severe, and the comprehensive ability of high-level skills is poor. Accordingly, the author puts suggestions to provide a practical reference and theoretical basis for front-line teachers to carry out the process evaluation of blended teaching.

articleTitle: Online and offline hybrid teaching mode based on scenario cases: a case study of MySQL databases
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Teaching mode design is a process to achieve the learning goal. Under the background of information technology, online and offline hybrid teaching mode has become the new form of education, and the closely related teaching mode design plays an essential role in the success of teaching implementation. Scenario case teaching can stimulate students' interest in learning and improve their ability to analyze and solve problems. Taking the MySQL database course as an example, this paper introduces the design and implementation process of online and offline hybrid teaching modes based on scenario cases. The practical results demonstrate that the hybrid teaching mode far outperforms the traditional teaching effect in terms of the aspects of students' basic knowledge of databases, practical operation level, and self-learning ability. Furthermore, this teaching mode has gained popularity in the studying of both our university and league universities.

articleTitle: Research hotspots and development trends of STEM education at home and abroad -- based on the analysis of citespace visualization
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: STEM education is regarded as a strategic choice for implementing the new educational reform in the 21st century. To sort out the evolution path of STEM education research at home and abroad in the past 14 years and reveal the research hotspots and trends of STEM education. In this paper, CiteSpace literature visualization analysis software is used to perform knowledge mapping visualization analysis on literature data with the theme of “STEM education” in the CNKI Chinese database and WOS core database during 2008-2021. The results show that STEM education is widely used in science education, curriculum design and information technology education at home and abroad. Domestic STEM education research focuses on K-12 education, which cultivates students' core literacy and innovation ability. Foreign STEM education research focuses on student development, student academic achievement and gender research in STEM education in higher education. This situation reveals the interdisciplinary, trans-regional and pluralistic nature of STEM education at home and abroad, presenting a trend of continuous integration and remodelling between STEM education and various disciplines.

articleTitle: The reform of artificial intelligence experiments based on Kaggle
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence will profoundly change the life of human society and change the world. Now, major colleges and universities regard artificial intelligence as the core professional curriculum, but the one-size-fits-all teaching method does not take into account the individual differences of students, and it is difficult for the quality of teaching to undergo essential changes. Aiming at the professional certification of engineering education, in accordance with the outputoriented talent training concept, reforming and exploring the problems in the experimental teaching of "artificial intelligence" courses, designing an experimental teaching system based on Kaggle open source competition data, and proposing diversified course assessment methods and evaluation methods better meet the needs of practical and innovative talent training in the era of big data.

articleTitle: Application of PBL in computer teaching of secondary vocational education
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's economy, the demand for high-quality technical and skilled talent is increasing. As a base for cultivating high-skilled talent, secondary vocational education plays an irreplaceable role in China's economic development. Therefore, secondary vocational schools must adopt more effective education and teaching methods to cultivate students' practical skills and improve their teaching quality. This paper analyzes the teaching effect and explores the teaching reform of secondary vocational schools by carrying out PBL (project-based learning) teaching in the graphic design course of computer specialty in secondary vocational schools.

articleTitle: Empirical research regarding teachers' satisfaction level towards training among higher vocational colleges in Hainan province
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of China's economy and labor market demand more and more skilled and highly qualified staff are needed. As the educational stronghold of highly qualified tanlets with technical skills, higher vocational colleges undertake the responsibility and mission of bringing those talents to the society. To ensure the supply of highly-qualified talents, training in regards to knowledge & skills and teaching abilities among teachers of higher vocational colleges must be reinforced. Through a combination of interview and questionnaire, this research takes teachers of Hainan higher vocational colleges as the object to acquire the current situation and problems that existed in the training thereupon. By means of a survey, it is found that teachers of Hainan higher vocational colleges are not so satisfied with the aforementioned training. There are problems like conflicts between training and teaching time, less flexibilities in training methods, and random evaluation standards upon training effects, which are mainly caused by a lack of cognition on the training, a single source of training budget, and incomplete training incentive mechanism. To implement the responsive supply of highly-qualified talents with technical skills, it is imperative to upgrade teachers' satisfaction level towards training and their vocational literacy among higher vocational colleges. Therefore, Hainan higher vocational colleges shall, based on meeting the demand of their teachers' vocational literacy, enhance the practicalness of the training contents, apply cutting-edge educational technology and advanced training methods, invest more funds to training hardware and software, and optimize and improve fostering & training system regarding teachers' qualifications.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of online learning behavior during the post-COVID-19 era
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, schools all over the world were closed and thereby students had to be instructed from distance. Consequently, the use of online learning environments for online distance learning increased massively. In this study, descriptive analysis and correlation analysis were carried out according to the learning data of online learning of Altitude Training course for ethnic traditional sports major and sports training major in the School of Physical Education of Yunnan Normal University. From this, the influence of online learning behavior investment is obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of influencing factors of middle school students' learning based on C5.0 decision tree
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Middle school is a critical period for the entire training of students. How to help teachers and students accurately analyze the key factors that affect middle school performance and determine the dependence between these factors and performance has become a problem that urgently needs to be solved. Based on the simulated test scores of 6298 junior high school students in a certain urban area of Kunming, this research designed a questionnaire on the “learning effects and development factors of middle school students” and conducted a statistical analysis of the students' scores and their responses to study the learning effects and development factors of middle school students' relevance. Based on the C5.0 decision tree algorithm, the information gain of each attribute is calculated, the decision tree is constructed, and the correlation between the learning effect of middle school students and development factors is found to optimize the training structure. The research results have clarified the factors that affect the teaching effect so that both teaching parties can benefit from them and jointly improve the teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research on mathematical expressions matching algorithms for computer algebra systems
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: For the interactive computer algebra system (CAS), to solve the matching problem of different mathematical expressions between students and CAS, this paper proposes a mathematical expression matching algorithm to achieve exact matching of different mathematical expressions between students and CAS. First, according to the MathML representation markup coding of the mathematical expression, the markup coding is parsed into the linear string representation of the expression by the back-end program, and the binary tree is generated after preprocessing it and then normalizing its tree structure and calculating the structured coding of the binary tree. For the two mathematical expressions to be matched, if their structure codings are the same, then compare their postorder and in-order traversal sequences. If they are the same, the two expressions are matched in the structure; go to the next step of the algorithm: matching the content of the mathematical expressions. For the binary tree of expressions with the same structure, the above traversal sequence is repeated to compare the obtained traversal sequence. The two expressions match if they are the same; otherwise, they do not match. The algorithm can realize exact matching between two mathematical expressions from the experimental results. When faced with mathematical expressions containing a large number of large integers, the matching of its structure is judged first. If it does not match, it can interrupt and exit and save time. It improves the running efficiency of the algorithm and is a convenient, fast, and practical algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on practical teaching reform of computer composition based on PBL+CDIO mode
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: In order to strengthen the concept of engineering education and cultivate students' professional ability and professional quality in teaching, aiming at the problems existing in the practical teaching of computer composition course, we put forward reform measures in aspects of experimental system, teaching design, organizational form and assessment method by using PBL+CDIO mode, strive to resolve in the practice teaching, How to embody "learning-centered"? How to cultivate students' computer system ability and computational thinking? How to evaluate the students for the cultivation of ability and quality. From the perspective of teaching effect, students' systematic ability and learning autonomy have been significantly improved compared with previous years.

articleTitle: Research on English proficiency of hotel employees in Sanya based on hierarchical clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The construction of Hainan Free Trade Port (FTP) puts forward higher requirements on the English proficiency of employees of all industries. As a pilot area for the construction of FTP, the pillar industry of Sanya is tourism and hotel industry, with a large number of employees. Therefore, 127 employees from 19 hotels in Sanya were selected as samples to conduct scientific research and evaluation on their English level. First, according to the “English Proficiency Scale of China” and “Guangdong Province Vocational English Test Outline”, a questionnaire is designed to investigate and identify the English levels of the hotel staff. Then, the reliability and validity of the questionnaire are tested, and the results show that both are high. Next, the hierarchical clustering model was used to stratify the samples into 4 levels (0 basic, primary, intermediate and advanced), accounting for 22.05%, 40.94%, 22.05% and 14.96%, respectively, which lays a solid foundation for providing scientific and effective English training programs. It has great value for local hotel management to improve their employees' English proficiency.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the satisfaction with the classroom teaching of the course of dietary nutrients and food hygiene
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: To understand how satisfied the students were with the course of Dietary Nutrients and Food Hygiene, Sanya Aviation Tourism Vocational college students were selected as the survey subjects to get the answer to that question. There were 25 questions in total designed for 5 dimensions in the questionnaire. Each dimension had 5 questions in it and they were: teacher's comprehensive capability, teaching environment, what has been taught, teaching method and the effect of teaching. Relevant factors influencing the students satisfaction were also analyzed. According to the study results, there are significant positive correlations between each two of these 5 variables and they are: the teacher's comprehensive capability had a significant positive influence on the teaching environment and what has been taught; the teaching environment had a significant positive influence on the teaching content and teaching method; last but not least, the teaching effect had a significant positive influence on the teaching method.

articleTitle: A summary of personalized learning research
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology has promoted the reform of both teaching and learning methods. Personalized learning has gradually become a new development trend. At the same time, technologies such as artificial intelligence, learning analysis and big data are also developing in depth, which is of significance to promoting the personalized development of students. To obtain a clearer understanding of the research status of personalized learning in our country. The paper was analyzed with the CiteSpace scientific knowledge graph analysis tool. The sample data of CNKI core journals from 2000 to 2021 were used. The sample data were analyzed by volume analysis, keyword co-occurrence analysis, cluster analysis, emergent analysis and timeline analysis. At the end of the article, the author made his own understanding and thinking about the development of personalized learning in the future.

articleTitle: Deep learning-based student's concentration analysis system
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Students' concentration status is not only an evaluation method for students' acceptance of courses but also an important reference factor for the quality of teachers' teaching. This paper proposes a deep learning-based student concentration analysis system. We use the methods and models of deep learning to analyze the concentration of students from two aspects of fatigue state and distraction behavior. The main contents are as follows: input each frame of the image obtained in the video stream into the third-party face recognition module Dlib and the retrained YOLOv5 series network model. The system mainly includes two modules: the human fatigue detection module detects the positions of the eyes and mouth through the key points of the face and calculates the opening and closing degrees of the eyes and mouth, and the constructor calculates the fatigue value of the student and gives a threshold to determine whether the student is in a fatigued state. The human behavior recognition module uses the YOLOv5 series of target detection models retrained after modifying the weights to identify objects other than faces that appear in the incoming images and judge students' behaviors according to the objects that appear.

articleTitle: Research on the open course system and evaluation of computer networks
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Computer Network is a course in which computer development and communication technology are closely integrated and continuously developed. Its theoretical development and application level directly reflect the development level of a country's high-tech, and it is an important symbol of its modernization degree and comprehensive national strength. In the process of informatization driving industrialization and industrialization promoting informatization, computer networks play an increasingly important role. According to the characteristics of the computer network course and years of experience in the course reform, this paper designs a new type of computer network online course system architecture, produces video open courses and experimental training microcourses of important knowledge points, and uses them as a useful supplement to classroom teaching. Through the development of a teaching auxiliary system, the informatization of the whole process of teaching activities is realized. This paper designs a process evaluation system, enriches the teaching evaluation method of the course, improves the online auxiliary teaching platform, expands the audience of online open courses, and applies it in practical teaching.

articleTitle: Research on the prediction model of the college student performance based on the multi-attention mechanism
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: In educational data mining, college student performance prediction aims to identify students who are at risk of dropping out as early as possible to facilitate early intervention in students' learning problems. Students' performance is influenced by their different behaviors and historical grades. Therefore, we propose a student performance prediction model based on a multiattention mechanism. This method uses a set of parallel attention mechanisms to calculate the weight of each behavioral feature on the grades of the last two semesters. In addition, another attention mechanism is used to calculate the balance score that can reflect the relationship between the two semesters. The features of the two are combined to obtain the final prediction result. We use a real college student performance dataset to verify our model. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model is superior to traditional methods. The model has good interpretability and practical application value.

articleTitle: BOPPPS-based online and offline blended teaching mode in computer basic course
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The worldwide pandemic of COVID-19 facilitates the widespread use of online and offline blended teaching mode. This mode could not only break through temporal and spatial limitations of traditional classroom teaching mode, but encourage students to avail themselves of the full range of the fragmented time as well. Computer basic course as one of general education curriculum has taken the lead in applying this mode in most institution of higher education. As a fashionable teaching mode, this mode suffers lacking focal points of knowledge as well as systematically theoretical basis. To circumvent its drawbacks and enrich its theoretical connotation, in this paper, we take computer basic course of a medical college as the research subject to conduct an experiment by introducing the BOPPPS teaching system into online and offline blended teaching mode. Three measurements including questionnaires, interviews and the final grades are used to compare and analyze the teaching effect of the blended teaching model. The results showed that for the computer basic course, the blended teaching model supported by online learning platform under the BOPPPS teaching system can effectively promote teaching quality, comprehensively improving students' knowledge and skills.

articleTitle: Research on community model construction of question-answering knowledge sharing
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The booming development of big data, the Internet of Things, cloud computing, artificial intelligence and mobile Internet technologies has led people to enter the "new information" era. In such an era, the emergence of knowledge sharing communities provides great convenience for human beings to search, acquire, communicate and share knowledge, and question-and-answer-type knowledge sharing communities are derived from virtual communities. Through the literature research method, this study outlines the development of knowledge sharing from six theories: social exchange theory, social capital theory capital, social influence theory, social cognitive theory and the technology acceptance model. The question-and-answer community knowledge sharing model is constructed by integrating six knowledge sharing models, such as the SECI knowledge transformation model and WSR-KS. Based on the knowledge and social characteristics of the Q&A-based knowledge sharing community, the construction of the Q&A-based community knowledge sharing model contains 3 dimensions and 14 aspects. The community itself builds a standardized system of management, the important qualities that knowledge sharing users need to have, and the clear organization of knowledge content are the important things that promote the long-term development of knowledge sharing in Q&A-based communities. The purpose of model construction is to promote the knowledge sharing and service functions of question-and-answer type knowledge communities.

articleTitle: The characteristics of chinese netizens' academic emotions: an online analysis of the National College Entrance Examination
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The academic emotions of students are of great concerns to researchers due to the development of modern education. As a vital event every 3rd-grade senior high school student in China must be involved in the Chinese National College Entrance Examination(NCEE), which can significantly influence academic emotions. Hence, it is meaningful to study the variation and change in academic emotions during certain periods of NCEE, especially in online social networks. In this article, we collected posts and replies from the Baidu NCEE Online Community and performed sentiment analysis with big data and national language techniques. The result indicates that the various academic emotions (positive high arousal, positive low arousal, negative high arousal, and negative low arousal) in an online social network fluctuate during the NCEE period and are related to gender and online experience of the special topic as NCEE. In addition, data mining techniques and emotion analysis are effective approaches for emotion research.

articleTitle: Practice-based study on design of promoting rural culture and tourism on the basis of computer VR technology
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: As computer virtual reality technology develops, it has a wider range of applications. In recent years, the technology has been gradually applied to projects on the promotion and design of rural culture and tourism as needs in such an area boost. Based on the concept of computer-based VR (Virtual Reality), the paper analyzed the important role and practical significance of the technology, elaborated specific methods and procedures when such technology was used in the promotion and design of rural culture and tourism, and investigated innovative methods in terms of research and practice in related programs. Problems encountered during the design practice of such programs were also analyzed in hopes of offering valuable references for the integration of promotion of rural culture and tourism nationwide and computer-based VR technology.

articleTitle: Subject classification algorithm of Chinese materials in university libraries based on the Bert model
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: At present, the construction of first-class disciplines in colleges and universities in our country is in full swing. It is of far-reaching significance to classify book resources with discipline labels, which is not only conducive to discipline construction but also a prerequisite for the construction of intelligent libraries. The traditional way of classifying books through manual experience is time-consuming and laborious, and some studies have introduced machine learning methods, but they only classify books in small specialized areas and do not take into account the current urgent need for subject classification work in university libraries. In this study, by using the BERT class pretraining model, the advantages of deep learning in feature extraction are fully utilized to extract features and classify topics for book resources, better book representations are learned, and good results are achieved on the test dataset. The experiments showed that in the best case, 94.12% of books were accurately predicted with corresponding subject labels on the subject label dataset. This study helps to realize the disciplinary label classification of book resources and has a positive effect on the librarians of university libraries to supplement the book resources with reasonable disciplinary classification labels.

articleTitle: Data-driven risk assessment and early warning of learning situations
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: At present, quality governance has become the internal demand of education reform and high-quality education system construction. First, this study analyzed the current research status and existing problems of early warning education in universities and colleges from the aspects of basic data, evaluation index, assessment method, and tool system application. Second, driven by learning situation big data analysis, this study puts forward a complete method system of risk assessment and early warning of learning situations, which consists of basic data collection and processing, index system construction and quantification, model construction and calculation, result expression and visualization, and a prototype information system was also realized by using modern software engineering and visualization technology. Finally, a specific course was taken as an example, and the application practice of learning situation risk assessment and early warning was carried out. The obtained results are very helpful to solve the problems of lagging early warning time, single evaluation factor, outdated technology and so on in traditional early warning education. It has reference significance for improving students' learning quality, teachers' teaching effect and early warning education management efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis on the new model of compound talent training under the background of “Artificial Intelligence + X”
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the new compound development model of “Artificial Intelligence + X”, the theoretical exploration of promoting multidisciplinary integration, creating a scientific practical operation environment, based on basic support, and realizing the whole process assessment is put forward. It shows the bold attempts of the “Intelligent Chemical Professional Core Curriculum System” and the programming language curriculum that the author's school has practiced in recent years and shares some of the teaching results that have been achieved. It deeply analyzes the criticality of compound teaching design and organization and points out the inevitability and trend of compound teaching development based on “Artificial Intelligence + X”, which will be tested, perfected and improved in practice in the future.

articleTitle: Design research for the online evidence-based teaching resource library
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The professional and scientific education disciplines require teachers to be evidence-based, track-based, and effective in teaching practices. In reality, teachers teach by experience, and there are difficulties in screening and assessing resources; teaching design lacks a scientific basis and assessment standards. Evidence-based teaching supports teachers in combining professional wisdom and the best evidence to carry out evidence-based teaching practice, but there is currently a lack of a resource library to support teachers in evidence-based teaching. In this study, the logical structure and architecture, platform rights management and user incentive mechanism, usage mode and evidence assessment indicators are designed for the resource library. Among them, the logical structure guarantees the rationality and scientific nature of the evidence. The architecture is designed to enable a development foundation. Platform rights management designs different rights for resource uploaders, users, administrators and intelligent systems and designs an urn/redeem points structure to motivate users to continuously upload evidence resources. A dedicated model of resource library use for teachers, researchers, and other visitors is designed to both standardize teachers' evidence-based teaching behaviors and allow researchers to tap into research questions with practical implications, conduct investigations, and upload resources for teachers to use. Users make suggestions based on the overall assessment indexes and the evidence-based evidence level assessment indexes for uploaders to modify and improve and then reupload the resources to realize the coconstruction and sharing of resources for coassessment. This research lays the foundation for the construction, application, promotion and improvement of the evidence-based teaching resource library and lays the groundwork for the scientific knowledge of sustainable development in the field of education.

articleTitle: Visual analysis of educational ethics from the perspective of intelligent education
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: Since the beginning of the 21st century, education and teaching supported by intelligent technology have undergone structural changes. The urgent need for educational ethical governance has become a problem to be solved at present. To propose the optimization path of educational governance requires a certain understanding of the status quo and trend of educational ethicsrelated research. Therefore, this paper uses atlas visualization, content analysis, bibliometric statistics and other methods to analyze the research on educational ethics. The conclusions are as follows: The researchers are mainly experts and scholars in the field of educational technology and some front-line teachers; The research institutions are mainly normal universities; The research content involves “ethical connotation”, “ethical risk”, “ethical problem”, “ethical code”, “ethical system”, “ethical code”, “ethical value”, “ethical morality” and so on. At present, the research status is mainly discussed in the environment of intelligent teaching systems, human - machine collaboration, intelligent robots, higher education, new engineering, educational ethics, technology empowerment, intelligent education and so on. Finally, in the background of educational artificial intelligence, based on a certain understanding of the development of educational ethics, combined with relevant literature content, further reveals some new thoughts on educational ethics generated by the application of educational artificial intelligence in education and teaching, to provide a reference for the proposal of new educational ethics.

articleTitle: Remote areas college students' online learning engagement investigation and improvement strategies
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and networks, online learning has become an important means for college students to acquire knowledge. The effectiveness of online learning for students is now at the forefront of research; compared with traditional classroom teaching, the form of online learning has changed tremendously in the learning situation. This research analyzes the factors that affect students' learning engagement through the implementation of an online course. The research shows that the influencing factors of learning engagement include learner self-factors, teacher, course content, peer learning and environmental factors. These 5 factors present a strong positive correlation with student engagement. Finally, the article proposes suggestions to improve learners' engagement in online learning environments.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of a teaching skills graph of information technology normal students
publicationTitle: Fourth International Conference on Computer Science and Educational Informatization (CSEI 2022)
abstract: The role of information technology courses in basic education is becoming more and more important. However, in the training of classroom teaching skills, due to the lack of practical application experience of teaching skills, it is difficult for information technology normal students to translate teaching skills theory into practical application.Which led to poor training effects and poor teaching effects. Therefore this paper used knowledge graph and ontology technology to build a skill graph that satisfies the teaching skills training of information technology normal students. First, aiming at the problem that the current skill knowledge was fragmented and unsystematic, and on the basis of screening and sorting out the selected data sources, it defines the teaching skill ontology quadruple TS={E, C, M, P} , and constructs it through the protégé ontology. Second, it built a hierarchical structure model of teaching skills ontology, and then used stuttering word segmentation, statistics-based TF-IDF keyword extraction method and graph-based Textrank keyword extraction algorithm to extract core knowledge points. Third, after the core knowledge pointswere determined, they were classified according to teaching skills. The core knowledge points were added to it in turn to improve various skills knowledge information, so that the skill graph had a hierarchical network structure. Finally, the neo4j graph database was used for storage and visualization. The construction of the skill graph can provide guidance for normal students in information technology classroom teaching training, so as to improve the effect of teaching skills training.
